Updated Daily by Analytics Simple Loader based on Pro settings. Dynamic Pricing is adjusting the cost of a lead based on a shopper's predicted intent to buy. Dynamic Pricing was first introduced on 5/5/2026 as a Pilot only available to State Farm and Farmers agents in the States of MN or AZ. With intent to extend to all Agents in the future.
